matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned source-document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Restricted cover, control/version page, persons and non-operative charges, communication/access chronology, attribution-layer table, legal-version questions, issues, applications and actions; neutral orientation only.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-26 pages; 300-500 words/narrative page and 12-26 sourced events/table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF from controlled source; searchable text, repeated headers, stable links; not scanned.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unresolved attribution fields, later platform-return version and corrected timezone mapping retained with dated history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Account, IP, household and complainant-contact data minimised by audience; client/court versions omit unrelated private data.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied messages, generic law extracts, repeated chronology, decorative network diagrams or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Signed complainant/household/provider statements, original-message exhibit register, receipt/impact timeline and device/network access accounts; records witnesses and context without proving sender.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-38 pages; statements 250-450 words/page and exhibit tables 8-22 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed scans and born-digital provider records; original files referenced, screenshots secondary and source-linked.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural witness uncertainty, changed device recollection and provider correction preserved as separate dated versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Addresses, credentials, third-party accounts and impact details restricted; only relevant served material reaches client/court.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated message bodies, duplicate declarations, generic impact prose, invented witnesses or empty exhibit rows.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: maker words not converted to facts
private fields absent from restricted exits

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Seizure/continuity records, acquisition worksheet, forensic-image record, hash manifest, examination scope/method, artefact findings, deleted/recovered data and limitations; proves method and lineage, not authorship.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 45-65 pages; technical narrative 250-450 words/page, artefact tables 10-28 rows/page and screenshots only when necessary.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native forensic image remains external and immutable; born-digital report/manifests; acquisition forms may be scans; hex/database images limited and legible.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unsupported artefact, partial recovery, tool warning, absent hash and later addendum are legitimate when explicit; no silent reprocessing.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privilege and unrelated household data filtered; full image access tightly controlled; court/client get authorised findings and limitations.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No raw dump pages, repeated hash tables, decorative hex, irrelevant artefacts, duplicated screenshots or invented tool output.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: report never equates token/account with user

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Native-like platform JSON package with preservation/receipt record, schema/data dictionary, validation log, message/event/account extracts, duplicate-key/schema-drift decisions and human-readable render.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 45-70 rendered-equivalent pages; 12-30 event rows/page, schema tables 8-20 fields/page; native JSON length follows actual records.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: UTF-8 JSON retained natively; safe non-executing parser; searchable born-digital render with stable record pointers. No JSON is embedded as executable content.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Schema migration, null fields, duplicate event, escaped Unicode and provider correction preserved with explicit policy/version.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Unrelated users and platform internals minimised; native access role-limited; redacted render retains stable source mapping.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No pretty-print whitespace inflation, repeated JSON and table render, invented fields, synthetic schema prose or one-record-per-page layout.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: EML/MSG preservation register, native messages, header analysis, HTML/plain-body comparison, attachments, forwarded-chain segmentation and readable render; preserves transport/content lineage.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 30-45 rendered-equivalent pages; 2-6 emails/page depending length, headers condensed but complete in appendix, attachments indexed 8-20/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native EML/MSG retained; HTML sanitised without remote loading/scripts; plain and HTML bodies separate; attachments enumerated, never auto-executed.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Broken inline image, conflicting Date/Received, duplicate message in thread and later provider export allowed with lineage.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Third-party addresses/content minimised; attachments and headers limited by relevance; privilege filter precedes service.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated quoted chains without deduplication note, duplicate HTML/plain bodies, decorative inbox screenshots or auto-expanded attachments.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: display From not called verified author
redactions cover headers and body consistently

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Provider request/return, CSV data dictionary, login/session/IP/device/subscriber schedules, normalisation notes and correlation tables; tests network/account events without person inference.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 35-50 rendered-equivalent pages; 18-40 rows/page with readable columns; methodology 250-450 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native CSV preserved byte-for-byte; born-digital safe render with repeated headers and text-preserved identifiers; formula-like cells neutralised only in export, raw retained.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Missing row, duplicate session, leading zero, DST offset and corrected provider column definition retained/versioned.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Subscriber/household/network data minimised; full returns role-limited; court/client get relevant rows and limits.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No spreadsheet-style empty rows, repeated correlation tables, invented geolocation, one-row-per-page or irrelevant subscriber periods.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: IP allocation period overlaps event or is qualified
network event not rendered as physical person/location

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Audio/video master and derivative register, acquisition/continuity, clip index, timed transcript, metadata extraction and speaker/event-attribution limitations.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-32 pages; registers 8-20 items/page, transcripts 35-70 turns/page and 1-4 justified stills/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native media external; born-digital registers/transcripts; stills preserve aspect ratio. Metadata extracted read-only and never treated as self-proving.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Variable frame rate, clock drift, inaudible passage, absent metadata and revised transcript allowed with explicit history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Bystander/household content restricted; full media access controlled; client/court receive authorised clip/transcript only.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated frames, full transcript duplicated per clip, invented metadata, decorative waveforms or artificial silence pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: clip never substitutes silently for master context

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Custody/interview and defence statements plus prosecution/defence digital-expert reports, materials, methods, addenda and dated agreements/disagreements; maker and expert positions remain distinct.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 35-50 pages; transcript 35-70 turns/page, reports 300-550 words/page and issue tables 6-16 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native interview audio external; born-digital transcript/reports; signed scans acceptable; technical appendices selective and source-linked.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Inaudibles, amended defence statement, changed expert opinion after late return and unresolved joint issue retained with versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence instructions/attendance notes privileged; served reports separate; unrelated device content excluded; client gets accessible summary.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated raw data, generic expert qualifications, duplicate transcript excerpts, invented tests or boilerplate opinion pages.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Disclosure schedules and decisions, defence requests/responses, later-return/service log, expert/hearsay applications, rulings, hearing notices/orders, deadline tracker and trial-readiness record.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 35-50 pages; schedules 10-25 rows/page, applications 250-500 words/page and deadline tables 8-18 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital schedules/forms/orders with stable IDs; signed/scanned orders where realistic; no hidden rows or embedded active content.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late platform return, revised schedule, adjourned hearing and corrected deadline allowed with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Sensitive schedules/internal advice/privilege role-limited; client/open versions exclude protected technical and personal data.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No boilerplate rows, copied legal tests, duplicate notices, artificial deadline worksheets or blank forms.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: late return does not erase prior state
